headline_marked: Police constable and wife [[arrested for cutting off child's finger]] in Natore
headline: Police constable and wife arrested for cutting off child's finger in Natore
summary: A 7-year-old boy's finger was allegedly severed by a police officer and his wife after a dispute between the children
details: A police constable and his wife have been arrested in Natore for allegedly cutting off a part of the seven-year-old boy's right index finger.
The incident occurred on Thursday afternoon in Natore city. The injured child was first taken to Natore Sadar Hospital and later transferred to Rajshahi for advanced treatment.
The suspects, who are a police constable serving in Natore and his wife, lived as tenants in the same building as the victim's father.
According to the victim's family, the incident was triggered by a vegetable cutter (hansua) used to sever the finger after the child was forcibly taken into the suspects' home.
The constable allegedly claimed that the child had sexually abused his four-year-old daughter, though police say no formal complaint was filed by the suspects.
Police searched the suspects' home and found bloodstains on the floor and bed, as well as a severed part of the child's finger.
The child's father, a bank employee, has filed a case against the couple. Both suspects were produced in court on Friday morning.

headline_marked: Trump shows [[close friendship with Xi Jinping]] during state visit
headline: Trump shows close friendship with Xi Jinping during state visit
summary: Donald Trump went to great lengths to show intimacy with the Chinese leader, including a tour of the White House helipad and a trip inside 'Marine One'.
details: US President Donald Trump made significant efforts to demonstrate a close personal bond with Chinese President Xi Jinping during his state visit to the United States.
Trump repeatedly touched Xi's arm and spoke of their 'truly great friendship', while showing him around the White House, including a satirical portrait of his predecessor, Joe Biden.
In an unprecedented move, Trump personally welcomed Xi at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland, becoming the first US president to do so for a Chinese leader.
The hospitality extended to Xi included a tour of the White House South Lawn helipad and an invitation inside the highly sensitive presidential helicopter, 'Marine One'.
Despite the atmosphere of friendship, the two leaders avoided questions from journalists regarding Iran, Taiwan, and artificial intelligence.
While Trump praised Chinese journalists as the 'friendliest in the world', analysts suggest Xi remained more reserved, focusing on state relations and 'red lines' on key issues.
Experts note that Trump's approach relies on personal chemistry, whereas Xi views the relationship through the lens of state power and strategic recognition.
Observers believe Xi is content to let Trump believe they are friends, as it provides China with the recognition and respect it seeks from the US.
caption:

US President Donald Trump made significant efforts to demonstrate a close personal bond with Chinese President Xi Jinping during his state visit to the United States.

Trump repeatedly touched Xi's arm and spoke of their 'truly great friendship', while showing him around the White House, including a satirical portrait of his predecessor, Joe Biden.

In an unprecedented move, Trump personally welcomed Xi at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland, becoming the first US president to do so for a Chinese leader.

The hospitality extended to Xi included a tour of the White House South Lawn helipad and an invitation inside the highly sensitive presidential helicopter, 'Marine One'.

Despite the atmosphere of friendship, the two leaders avoided questions from journalists regarding Iran, Taiwan, and artificial intelligence.

While Trump praised Chinese journalists as the 'friendliest in the world', analysts suggest Xi remained more reserved, focusing on state relations and 'red lines' on key issues.

Experts note that Trump's approach relies on personal chemistry, whereas Xi views the relationship through the lens of state power and strategic recognition.

Observers believe Xi is content to let Trump believe they are friends, as it provides China with the recognition and respect it seeks from the US.
